units.source_text: “于是，我产生了一个念头，对于以前任由叔叔打理的家产，如果不彻底搞清楚的话，便对不起父母的在天之灵。

en.t: And so I began to feel that, unless I thoroughly understood the family property I had previously left entirely in my uncle's hands, I would be failing my late parents.

units.source_text: 而叔叔总是口口声声地说事务繁忙，事实也确如其所说。

en.t: My uncle was always saying that he was busy with affairs, and in fact things did seem to be just as he said.

units.source_text: 他每晚都居无定所，常常回家住两天，在市里住上三天，

en.t: He did not sleep in the same place every night, often spending two days at home and then three days in town,

units.source_text: 两头奔波，每天都过着忙得不可开交的日子，‘太忙了’成了他的口头禅。

en.t: going back and forth between the two places, living every day in a state of frantic busyness, until "I am too busy" became his constant refrain.

units.source_text: 在我还没起疑心的时候，也曾以为他真的很忙。

en.t: Before I began to feel suspicious, I too had thought he really was busy.

units.source_text: 而且，我还不无讥讽地理解为：若不忙碌，就跟不上潮流了。

en.t: I even interpreted it, with a touch of irony, as meaning that unless one was busy, one could not keep up with the times.

units.source_text: 但是，当我想要就财产问题，跟他好好坐下来谈一谈的时候，

en.t: But when I wanted to sit down with him and have a proper talk about the property,

units.source_text: 再看他那副忙碌的样子，只能认为这不过是他故意躲避我的借口而已。

en.t: his busy manner could only seem to me like nothing more than an excuse deliberately used to avoid me.

units.source_text: 总之，我很难找到跟叔叔摊牌的机会。

en.t: In short, it was very hard for me to find an opportunity to confront my uncle openly.

units.source_text: 我听闻叔叔在市里养着个外宅，这是中学时的一个朋友告诉我的。

en.t: I heard that my uncle was keeping a mistress in town; this was told to me by a friend from my middle school days.

units.source_text: 纳妾这事本身，对于叔叔而言不足为奇，但在父亲活着的时候，

en.t: The fact of keeping a mistress in itself was not especially surprising for my uncle, but while my father was still alive,

units.source_text: 我不曾听闻，因此不觉愕然。

en.t: I had never heard anything of the kind, and so I could not help being astonished.

units.source_text: 此外，这位朋友还告诉了我有关叔叔的许多传闻。

en.t: In addition, this friend told me many other rumors about my uncle.

units.source_text: 其中一件是，有一个时期，人们都以为他的事业面临破产，

en.t: One of them was that there had been a time when people thought his business was on the verge of bankruptcy,

units.source_text: 然而这两三年又突然红火了起来。

en.t: yet over the past two or three years it had suddenly begun to prosper again.

units.source_text: 这个消息也加深了我的怀疑。

en.t: This news also deepened my suspicions.
